selected_subsets_rule: exact equality of subset sets, including their identities
global_dimension_rule: exact equality of the PA global dimensional decision
quantiles_rule: same decision-quantile identities and every relative change strictly less than tolerance
epsilon_q_definition: smallest positive normal float64, only numerical zero protection
production_rule: first eligible checkpoint meeting all three conditions simultaneously
validation_rule: evaluate every prefix through B=2000 even if production could stop earlier
